name: צְפַנְיָהוּ
gloss: Yahweh has hidden; or Yahweh has treasured
summary: Borne by the prophet Zephaniah son of Cushi, a descendant of Hezekiah, who prophesied in the days of Josiah (Zep 1:1); by Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, the priest of the second rank, whom Zedekiah sent to Jeremiah and who read Shemaiah's letter to him, taken by the captain of the guard to Riblah when Jerusalem fell (Jer 21:1; 29:25, 29; 37:3; 2Ki 25:18; Jer 52:24); by the father of Josiah, at whose house the exiles from Babylon gathered (Zec 6:10, 14); and by a Kohathite ancestor of Heman the singer (1Ch 6:21), whom TIPNR joins to Uriel. The name is the qal of צָפַן with יָהוּ: “Yahweh has hidden”, as the psalmist says, “he will hide me in his shelter in the day of trouble” (Psa 27:5), or “has treasured”, as Yahweh's people are “your treasured ones” (Psa 83:4). Scripture does not explain it, but the prophet's own call is that the humble seek Yahweh, “perhaps you will be hidden in the day of Yahweh's anger” (Zep 2:3, with סָתַר).

evidence.note: “The word of Yahweh which came to צְפַנְיָה son of Cushi … in the days of Josiah.”
“Seek Yahweh, all the humble of the land … perhaps you will be hidden (תִּסָּתְרוּ) in the day of Yahweh's anger.”
“He will hide me (יִצְפְּנֵנִי) in his shelter in the day of trouble”: the verb of the name, with Yahweh as subject.
“They conspire against your treasured ones (צְפוּנֶיךָ)”: Yahweh's people.
Zedekiah sent “צְפַנְיָה son of Maaseiah the priest” to Jeremiah.
“Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.”
“Zephaniah the second priest”, taken when Jerusalem fell; also Jer 52:24.
“The house of Josiah son of Zephaniah”; Zec 6:14 the same.
In the line of Heman: “son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah”.

note: Drafted 2026-11-18. BDB r.di.ag (10 tokens). TIPNR merges the priest of 2Ki 25:18 with the son of Maaseiah of Jer 21:1 (record 3006), and the ancestor of Heman (1Ch 6:21 Hebrew, 6:36 English) with Uriel (Uriel@1Ch.6.24); kept as TIPNR has them. Whether the perfect is “hidden” (protected) or “treasured” is not decided by scripture; both are senses of the qal.
